# minds.wisconsin.edu

> > A diverse knowledge repository covering entertainment guides, language reference materials, and Colorado public policy news.

This site aggregates content from TV Guide entertainment listings and streaming recommendations, multilingual dictionary resources (Cambridge Dictionary, Wiktionary, Dictionary.com), Colorado state news on drug policy and outdoor recreation, and translation tools. It serves as a curated information hub spanning media, language learning, and regional affairs.

## Key Topics

- Netflix streaming recommendations
- TV Guide listings and schedules
- Colorado drug policy and harm reduction
- Safe injection sites legislation
- Cambridge Dictionary definitions
- Fentanyl and opioid crisis
- Colorado Parks and Wildlife
- Entertainment news and celebrity coverage
- Multilingual translation resources
- Preposition and adverb usage
- Streaming services (Prime Video, Paramount+)
- Colorado State Capitol legislation
- Language learning tools
- TV season guides and previews

## Entertainment & Streaming Guides

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): TV Guide homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV Guide listings page for TV schedules and channel information
- [The Complete Guide to Winter TV 2025-2026: Everything to Know About What to Watch This Season - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/features/winter-tv-guide-2025): Comprehensive winter 2025-2026 TV season guide with streaming previews
- [The 55 Best Shows on Netflix Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/the-best-shows-on-netflix): TV Guide curated list of 55 best Netflix shows including Vladimir
- [The 61 Best Movies on Netflix Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): TV Guide recommendations for 61 best Netflix movies featuring Jurassic World
- [Cary, NC TV Guide - Tonight's Antenna, Cable or Satellite TV Schedule - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/listings/zip/27518-cary-nc): Local TV schedule listings for Cary, NC antenna and cable providers

## Language Reference & Dictionaries

- [ABOUT | English meaning - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/about): Cambridge Dictionary English definition of 'about' with examples
- [ABOUT中文(简体)翻译：剑桥词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/zhs/词典/英语-汉语-简体/about): Cambridge Dictionary English-Chinese translation entry for 'about'
- [about - Wiktionary, the free dictionary](https://en.m.wiktionary.org/wiki/about): Wiktionary entry with etymology and definitions for 'about'
- [ABOUT Definition & Meaning | Dictionary.com](https://dictionary.com/browse/about): Dictionary.com definition and usage examples for 'about'
- [在线翻译是什么意思_在线翻译的翻译_音标_读音_用法_例句_爱词霸在线词典](https://iciba.com/word): Chinese online translation dictionary supporting 177 languages

## Colorado Public Policy & News

- [Colorado Dems kill 'safe injection site' bill for drug users | AP News](https://apnews.com/article/safe-injection-sites-overdose-fentanyl-opioid-drug-colorado-12b38b22162ce4b79e81477dc9fcc682): AP News article on Colorado Democrats killing safe injection site bill
- [Colorado Dems kill "safe injection site" bill for drug users - CBS Colorado](https://cbsnews.com/colorado/news/colorado-democrats-kill-safe-injection-site-bill-drug-users): CBS coverage of Colorado safe injection site bill defeat
- [Camping | Colorado Parks and Wildlife](https://cpw.state.co.us/camping): Colorado Parks and Wildlife camping reservations and info page
